label: Card
description: A titled container that groups related fields and widgets on a page, like a block in a document. Use a card for each coherent topic of a record (Details, Assignment, Resolution). Cards live inside columns or tabs and lay their fields out in a one- or two-column grid.
usage: Group 2–10 related fields; split larger groups into several cards.
Give every card a short noun-phrase title ("Assignment", not "Assignment information section").
Place a new card next to related cards using an anchor (after the card it follows) rather than at the end of the page.
Use columns: 2 only in wide columns (span 6 or more).
constraints: Parent must be layout.column or layout.tab.
Children must be field placements, display elements, action.button, action.action_menu, or collection.related_list.
title is required and at most 60 characters.

description.description: Optional one-line helper text under the title.

columns.description: Field grid columns inside the card.

binding.description: Children bind to fields of the page's record.

accessibility.keyboard: Collapsible cards toggle with Enter or Space on the heading button.
accessibility.notes: The title is the region's accessible name (aria-labelledby). Heading level follows the page outline.

responsive: Fills its column. A two-column field grid collapses to one column below 720px.

examples.description: Assignment card with three fields in a two-column grid
